item.title: IntelliGRC: $3.5 Million Seed Round Raised For Cybersecurity GRC Platform For MSPs
item.description: IntelliGRC, a cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform designed for managed service providers (MSPs) and managed security service providers (MSSPs), announced it has closed a $3.5 million seed funding round. The investment, finalized on January 31, 2026, will support product innovation, expand artificial intelligence capabilities, and accelerate go-to-market efforts as the company scales its Governance, Risk Management, and Compliance as a Service (GRCaaS) platform. item.title: Candid Therapeutics: $505 Million Financing And Merger With Rallybio To Advance Autoimmune T-Cell Engager Pipeline
item.description: Rallybio Corporation announced a merger agreement with clinical-stage biotechnology company Candid Therapeutics, a deal that will create a combined company focused on developing T cell engager therapies for autoimmune diseases. Upon completion of the transaction, the combined company will operate as Candid Therapeutics and trade on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol CDRX. item.title: Coincheck Group: Acquisition Of Digital Asset Manager 3iQ
item.description: Coincheck Group N.V., a Netherlands-based holding company for the Japanese crypto exchange Coincheck, has completed its acquisition of approximately 99.8% of 3iQ Corp., a Canada-based digital asset investment manager. The transaction closed on February 28, 2026, following the earlier announcement of a stock purchase agreement on January 8, 2026. item.title: Qualcomm: AI-Native Wi-Fi 8 Portfolio Introduced With FastConnect 8800 Connectivity System
item.description: Qualcomm Technologies announced the launch of its AI-native Wi-Fi 8 portfolio, unveiling a range of connectivity and networking platforms designed to support the next generation of artificial intelligence-driven devices and networks. The announcement was made at MWC Barcelona and includes the Qualcomm FastConnect 8800 Mobile Connectivity System along with five new Qualcomm Dragonwing networking infrastructure platforms. item.title: Nvidia: $2 Billion Investment In Lumentum To Advance AI Data Center Optics
item.description: Nvidia announced a multiyear strategic partnership with Lumentum Holdings to accelerate innovation in advanced optical technologies used in next-generation AI infrastructure. item.title: RadNet: $270 Million Acquisition Of Radiology AI Company Gleamer
item.description: RadNet, a U.S.-based provider of outpatient diagnostic imaging services, announced it has acquired Paris-based radiology artificial intelligence company Gleamer in a deal valued at up to €230 million, or about $270 million. The company said the acquisition will integrate Gleamer into its DeepHealth digital health subsidiary, expanding the platform’s clinical AI capabilities and positioning it as the largest provider of radiology clinical AI solutions worldwide.
